If we choose the parameters (s, λ1/λ2, θ1/θ2, a) = (2, 0.34, 11, 2.89) the sign variation of Vs(x) is “−, +, −” so, according to Theorem 2.2, X and Y are not comparable with respect to the 2−IFRA order, hence they cannot be comparable with respect to the 2−IFR order. ... (λ1, λ2, θ1, θ2) = (1/1474)(408, 1200, 134, 1474)ϑ, with ϑ > 0, generates a whole family of counter-examples for the conjecture when the iteration parameter s = 2.
model: parallel systems of two exponentials with majorized rate vectors
family: max of two exponentials, rates (λ1, λ2) ≺ (θ1, θ2)
